document.title: Instructions for Form PENS.E/7-A — Election to Defer Choice of Benefit (5 years or more of contributory service)

chunks.heading: Purpose of form PENS.E/7-A
chunks.text: A participant with five years or more of contributory service may, upon separation, defer their benefit election for up to 36 months under article 32. Form PENS.E/7-A elects to defer the choice of benefit. To elect a benefit and receive payment, form PENS.E/7-B should be used instead.

chunks.heading: Interest accrual note
chunks.text: Interest is accrued in the participant's account only until the date of separation, not during the deferment period.

chunks.heading: Effect of resuming participation during deferment
chunks.text: If the participant elects to defer and resumes participation in the Fund within the 36-month deferment period, participation is deemed continuous and no payment is made until the participant separates again. The intervening break in service is not pensionable, though non-contributory service may potentially be validated under article 23.

chunks.heading: Deadline to submit the final benefit election
chunks.text: The participant may request payment of the benefit at any time during the deferment period, but at the latest by the end of the 36-month period, by submitting form PENS.E/7-B.

chunks.heading: What happens if PENS.E/7-B is not submitted in time
chunks.text: If the participant fails to submit form PENS.E/7-B within the 36-month deferment period, the Fund automatically deems that the participant has elected a deferred retirement benefit under article 32(c).

chunks.heading: Forfeiture of benefit entitlement
chunks.text: The right to a retirement, early retirement, deferred retirement, or disability benefit, or a surviving spouse's, divorced surviving spouse's, child's, or secondary dependant's benefit, is forfeited if, for five years after the first payment becomes due, the beneficiary fails to submit payment instructions or fails/refuses to accept payment.

chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/7-A
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information; Section 2 - Emergency contact; Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.heading: How to submit form PENS.E/7-A
chunks.text: The dated and hand-signed form is returned to the secretary of the Staff Pension Committee, or directly to UNJSPF for UN family staff members, via MSS Document Upload or mailed to UNJSPF's New York or Geneva offices.
